changelog:
Version 8.2.0

Fixed

  • Cached pages now keep the response headers the page sends, such as security headers and search-engine directives.
  • After applying settings or clearing the cache, pages already in the cache keep being served while they are rebuilt, instead of being removed again a minute later.
  • The diagnostic link that shows a page without optimisation tells search engines not to index it.
  • A cache purge is only reported when the host has a cache that can be purged.
